card.name: The word see in cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "see" opening a bracketed cross-reference such as [see Adverse Reactions (6)], mostly after a hypersensitivity contraindication. It also fires on "and" between cross-referenced section names.

modes.label: See in brackets
modes.description: "see" right after an opening bracket, pointing to another label section.
modes.example: Patients with known hypersensitivity to any of the components of Lactated Ringer’s Injection [<<see>> Warnings and Precautions (5

modes.label: And between sections
modes.description: "and" joining two cross-referenced section names inside the bracket.
modes.example: contraindicated because of hypotension [ see Contraindications (4.2)<< and>> Clinical Pharmacology (12.2
